orders.name: Intro

Intro.greenSegment — The green landscape and winding snake-like road open Linkers.
Intro.upperSegments — University, research, medical imaging, and an imaginary market connect to their sections.
Intro.sea — The sea and child motif link to future work.
nextSteps: Refine the illustrated segments as the destinations develop.

orders.name: Linkers
orders.title: Linkers coastal journey
orders.summary: An interactive coastal map turns the blue road, cloud, and Kuzey Marmara sign into destinations.
requirements: Linkers.road — Follow the blue winding road to the future-work page.
Linkers.cloud — Open the next-step cloud page from the header or illustration.
Linkers.board — Use the Kuzey Marmara sign to reach the browser games.
nextSteps: Add new destinations when their corresponding workspaces are ready.

orders.name: BrowserGames
orders.title: Kuzey Marmara games
orders.summary: Play an original resource board game or a synthetic-market trading game in the browser.
requirements: BrowserGames.board — Roll, gather resources, and build stations on an original board.
BrowserGames.market — Practice trading against invented market prices using imaginary coins.
BrowserGames.expansion — Consider more small web games inspired by familiar board and card mechanics.
nextSteps: Choose the next game to build; multiplayer and additional game types are not connected.

orders.name: AISynthesis
orders.title: MRI synthesis studio
orders.summary: Choose a model workflow and dataset, spend demo credits, and download its matching Python code.
requirements: AISynthesis.selection — Choose a named model workflow without writing code.
AISynthesis.code — Generate downloadable Python code and configuration for the selection.
AISynthesis.output — Inspect paired synthetic demonstration volumes in the MRI explorer.
AISynthesis.inference — A real trained-model inference service remains to be connected; current outputs are prepared demonstrations.
nextSteps: Supply validated model weights, runtime requirements, and inference hosting before enabling real synthesis.

orders.name: DemoTokens
orders.title: Imaginary token wallet
orders.summary: Demo credits can be replenished and spent on synthesis demonstrations; they have no monetary value.
requirements: DemoTokens.balance — Show the current account or guest credit balance.
DemoTokens.refill — Add imaginary credits through the demo refill action.
DemoTokens.ledger — Charge each synthesis request once and preserve the resulting job.
DemoTokens.value — No real payments, cryptocurrency, redemption, or cash value.
nextSteps: Keep demo credits distinct from any future paid AI service usage.

orders.name: FederatedLab
orders.title: Federated learning lab
orders.summary: Select datasets, prepare a federated configuration, and manage private dataset uploads and downloads.
requirements: FederatedLab.datasets — Choose built-in datasets or upload, import, and download private datasets through the dataset library.
FederatedLab.configuration — Set aggregation strategy, clients, rounds, and local epochs; export the configuration.
FederatedLab.training — Real distributed training and participating compute clients remain future work.
FederatedLab.documents — The lab links to the policies and documentation roadmap in Orders; public policy pages and government documentation remain planned under VaultPolicies.
nextSteps: Connect training infrastructure and implement the policies and government documentation areas described in the linked roadmap.

orders.name: MRIExplorer
orders.title: MRI explorer
orders.summary: Explore anatomical reference and synthetic volumes with linked slice views and a 3D viewer.
requirements: MRIExplorer.views — Navigate axial, coronal, sagittal, and 3D views.
MRIExplorer.localFiles — Open compatible local volumes in the browser.
MRIExplorer.privateFiles — View the signed-in account's saved datasets.
MRIExplorer.purpose — Educational and research visualization; no diagnostic model is connected.
nextSteps: Extend supported research workflows as appropriate datasets and models are supplied.

orders.name: GeneticsAndEEG
orders.title: Genetics & EEG research
orders.summary: Private owner-managed research drafts for genetic mutation classification, EEG, and collaboration opportunities.
requirements: GeneticsAndEEG.genetics — Define the mutation-classification research problem, datasets, and evaluation plan.
GeneticsAndEEG.eeg — Define the signal-processing and EEG learning experiments.
GeneticsAndEEG.opportunities — Keep proposed collaboration and funding details inside the owner workspace.
GeneticsAndEEG.access — Require verified owner access and the administration key.
nextSteps: The owner defines the research scope and approves any opportunity before publication.

orders.name: Vault
orders.title: The vault challenge
orders.summary: A signed-in educational puzzle awards a one-time imaginary-credit reward.
requirements: Vault.access — Sign in to open the challenge and attach progress to the account.
Vault.challenge — Solve an educational puzzle to receive the demo reward once.
Vault.prize — Any future real prize needs separate rules and funding; the current reward has no cash value.
Vault.policy — The vault links to the policies and documentation roadmap in Orders. The separate policy section remains planned.
nextSteps: Build the VaultPolicies section described in the linked roadmap and define any future challenge expansion.

orders.name: VaultPolicies
orders.title: Policies & documentation
orders.summary: Planned public policies, a verified certification register, and a separate government document area.
requirements: VaultPolicies.public — Create website terms, vault rules, privacy and data-use information, storage/cookie information, demo-token rules, and research/dataset-use policies.
VaultPolicies.regulations — Identify applicable jurisdictions and add sourced regulatory references before making compliance claims.
VaultPolicies.certifications — List certifications only when their issuer, scope, reference number, dates, and verification evidence have been provided. No certifications have been supplied.
VaultPolicies.documents — Make designated public documentation available to visitors.
VaultPolicies.government — Plan /government/documents for approved government accounts with database-assigned roles and server-side document permissions.
VaultPolicies.governmentAccess — Include owner approval and revocation, account/password or key authentication, and access history for restricted documents.
VaultPolicies.links — Link the policy and document areas from Vault and FederatedLab.
nextSteps: Supply the organization details, operating jurisdictions, official evidence, and documents to publish.
Build the restricted account and document controls before accepting government-only files.

orders.name: RedRoom
orders.title: Red Room member space
orders.summary: An invitation-only member lounge protected by account sign-in, site membership ID, and a room password.
requirements: RedRoom.login — Require a signed-in member account and the owner-managed room password.
RedRoom.memberId — Use the site-issued membership ID; the demonstration does not collect passport numbers or identity documents.
RedRoom.access — Keep private room access separate from the public learning pages.
nextSteps: The owner configures room access and decides which member research materials to include.

orders.name: ResearchJournal
orders.title: Research journal
orders.summary: Browse a curated publication and researcher catalog, source links, and downloadable citations.
requirements: ResearchJournal.people — Show the participating researchers and available scholarly profile links.
ResearchJournal.papers — Include the supplied MRI synthesis, directional market prediction, and SANS research entries with source and verification information.
ResearchJournal.discovery — Search and filter publications by researcher and topic.
ResearchJournal.sync — The catalog is curated; automatic complete Google Scholar synchronization remains unconnected.
nextSteps: Verify new publications and profile affiliations before adding them to the journal.

orders.name: InstallableApp
orders.title: Installable web app
orders.summary: Install the web experience on compatible desktop and mobile browsers.
requirements: InstallableApp.web — Provide browser installation and home-screen access.
InstallableApp.devices — Support responsive use on modern MacBooks, phones, and other compatible devices.
InstallableApp.native — A C-based desktop program or separate native mobile binary has not been built.
InstallableApp.privateData — Keep sign-in, private records, and server actions online.
nextSteps: Define a separate native application scope if a native download is needed.

orders.name: HPC_VPN
orders.title: HPC & VPN hosting
orders.summary: Plan a university or HPC deployment accessible only to approved VPN users.
requirements: HPC_VPN.hosting — Establish whether the institution permits a web server on the selected HPC or affiliated host.
HPC_VPN.access — Design a deployment restricted to authorized VPN users.
HPC_VPN.operations — Define institutional hosting, authentication, storage, and compute arrangements.
nextSteps: Obtain the institution's hosting requirements and an approved deployment target. The current demonstration remains on its existing public host.

orders.name: Business
orders.title: Business & personal collection
orders.summary: A visual private inventory for property, vehicles, valuables, hardware, expenses, and a custom leather bag.
requirements: Business.assets — Visually present cars, houses, yachts, diamonds, gold, and silver using supplied photos and records.
Business.wallet — Record manually entered USD and CAD balances and international expenses with dates, countries, currencies, amounts, descriptions, and categories.
Business.hardware — Organize watches, wearables, phones, SIM cards, and associated records.
Business.documentBag — Showcase a self-designed leather document bag with AI-assisted text and the requested Taylor Swift-inspired design or lettering, without claiming an official affiliation.
Business.documentBag.spotifyButton — Add a My Spotify button that opens the owner's supplied Spotify profile or selected playlist; the destination has not been provided.
Business.access — Keep real personal inventory and wallet details private to the owner. Any public preview uses clearly identified invented items.
Business.data — Real asset inventories, photos, account balances, and banking connections have not been supplied.
nextSteps: Build the visual /business page and private inventory records.
Supply the first asset photos, the bag design direction, and the Spotify destination.
Clarify the intended additional wallet label mentioned in the original request.

orders.name: MATLAB
orders.title: MATLAB workspace
orders.summary: MATLAB is on the order list; its intended page and workflow still need to be defined.
requirements: MATLAB.scope — Decide whether this means downloadable scripts, analysis examples, a learning page, or an execution integration.
MATLAB.runtime — Determine any required MATLAB environment and licensing after the scope is chosen.
nextSteps: Describe the MATLAB task, expected inputs, and desired outputs.

orders.name: CentralAIChat
orders.title: Central AI chat
orders.summary: A central chat page with private saved conversations and a ChatGPT tool bridge. Automatic in-app AI replies await an API service connection.

CentralAIChat.history — Save conversations privately for each signed-in account through the app's backend.
CentralAIChat.connection — Provide authorized tools for ChatGPT to read the order list and the signed-in user’s saved conversations and post replies to that user’s chat.

nextSteps: Configure the AI service credential securely, verify automatic replies, and confirm the ChatGPT connection before marking those capabilities active.

orders.name: TerminalAndLogs
orders.title: Terminal & job logs
orders.summary: A planned private administration terminal and read-only job-log view for an approved Linux or HPC server.
requirements: TerminalAndLogs.shell — Offer an interactive SSH-like command line through an authenticated backend connected to the selected Linux or HPC server.
TerminalAndLogs.target — Select the server and establish an authorized authentication session first. A webpage does not receive direct access to a visitor’s laptop shell.
TerminalAndLogs.logs — Show command output and job logs in a separate read-only view.
TerminalAndLogs.access — Restrict terminal access to administrators, isolate each user’s session, clean up disconnected sessions, and apply VPN restrictions where required by institutional policy.
TerminalAndLogs.ai — Let AI explain or draft commands. Any future execution must be explicitly authorized, visible, and recorded; automatic execution is not implemented.
TerminalAndLogs.state — No server has been supplied, no terminal connection is active, and no commands have been run through this feature.
nextSteps: Provide the approved server or HPC target and its connection requirements.
Build the authenticated terminal and log views before enabling any command execution.

orders.name: AIEnsemble
orders.title: AI ensemble workspace
orders.summary: A planned workspace that asks several AI providers the same task, shows their individual conversations, and compares their answers in a combined response.
requirements: AIEnsemble.providers — Consider OpenAI, Gemini, and Claude through supported provider APIs with the required credentials and account access. Existing consumer chat accounts do not automatically connect these services.
AIEnsemble.parallel — Send the same selected prompt or topic to the configured providers in parallel and display a separate conversation box for each provider.
AIEnsemble.synthesis — Let a coordinator compare and combine responses while preserving disagreements, available citations, model attribution, provider errors, and incomplete results.
AIEnsemble.students — Support private student accounts and appropriately scoped course sessions; define sharing and participation before pooling student conversations or data.

AIEnsemble.mriTask — Treat the requested 159 slices as a proposed MRI task configuration whose exact meaning still needs clarification. Input dimensions, datasets, model choices, and compute resources have not been supplied.
AIEnsemble.jobs — Show task queues, progress, cancellation, and results when real execution infrastructure is connected. No ensemble model inference is currently running.
AIEnsemble.federated — Keep multi-model answer comparison distinct from federated learning, which has its own data, training, and infrastructure requirements.
AIEnsemble.evaluation — Evaluate the combined answer against task-specific criteria. Combining providers does not guarantee correctness, agreement, or superior results.
AIEnsemble.state — Provider credentials are not configured. The prepared central chat is a separate feature and is not an active multi-provider ensemble.
nextSteps: Choose the first providers and establish supported API connections.
Clarify the 159-slice task and define its input, expected output, evaluation criteria, and authorized compute resources.
Build the parallel conversations, coordinator, and task controls after those requirements are confirmed.

orders.name: RealtimeVoice
orders.title: Real-time voice conversations
orders.summary: Planned spoken conversations with microphone input, AI audio replies, interruption controls, and a typed-chat fallback.
requirements: RealtimeVoice.conversation — Support bidirectional real-time speech input and audio output through compatible provider APIs.
RealtimeVoice.controls — Request explicit microphone permission and provide clear listening, mute, stop, and interruption controls.
RealtimeVoice.fallback — Keep typed input and readable replies available when voice is unavailable or the user prefers text.
RealtimeVoice.providers — Verify each selected provider’s supported speech and real-time APIs before claiming compatibility or enabling a voice.
RealtimeVoice.siri — Consider Siri or Apple voice entry only where supported platform capabilities allow it; do not assume a direct Siri conversation API or automatic account integration.
RealtimeVoice.ensemble — Coordinate voice with the planned AI ensemble while preserving which model produced each answer.

RealtimeVoice.execution — Spoken commands may be explained or drafted. Any future server execution follows the separate explicit authorization and visible execution controls in TerminalAndLogs, order 18.
RealtimeVoice.state — Voice services and provider credentials are not configured; no live microphone or audio conversation is connected.
nextSteps: Choose a supported speech provider and configure the required API connection.
Define browser and device targets, then build and verify permission, interruption, audio playback, and text fallback behavior.
